resources.string: Trip monitoring, route matching, and the full-screen alert are built (see mobile/PROGRESS.md) but not yet wired together end to end - that\'s milestone 7.
Start monitoring automatically when driving is detected
Needed to find fuel prices near you and match them against your route. Only used while a trip is active.
Needed so price checks keep running while you\'re driving and the app isn\'t on screen. Requested only after Location above is granted - Android requires these as two separate steps.

Needed for the deal alert to show over your lock screen, the way an alarm does. On newer Android versions this can\'t be requested with a normal in-app prompt - tapping below opens a system settings screen instead.
